_national.labelling: Each of the 22 wine districts (borvidek) is a PDO (OEM, "oltalom alatt allo eredetmegjelolés", or "vedett eredetu"), with smaller village, varietal and umbrella PDOs on top; regional PGIs (OFJ) such as Duna-Tisza-kozi, Felso-Magyarorszag, Balaton, Dunantul. Hungarian must weight is in degrees MM (Magyar Mustfok, roughly % sugar by weight). PDO specifications commonly use the tiers Classicus, Superior/Premium and Grand Superior/Super Premium.
_national.sweetness: EU terms: szaraz (dry) max 4 g/l (or 9 with acidity rule), felszaraz max 12 (18), feledes max 45, edes over 45 g/l.

src.title: Villany PDO product specification, version 5 (harvests from 1 Aug 2019)

hu-debroi-harslevelu.labelling: Varietal PDO within the Eger district (registered 2007) for Harslevelu from Debro.

hu-eger.varieties: Whites incl. Leanyka, Kiralyleanyka, Olaszrizling, Harslevelu, Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc, Sauvignon Blanc, Szurkebarat, Juhfark, Muscats; reds incl. Kekfrankos, Kadarka, Kekoporto (Portugieser), Blauburger, Zweigelt, Merlot, Cabernets, Pinot Noir, Syrah, Turan, Menoire, Bibor Kadarka, Csokaszolo.
hu-eger.min_alcohol: Superior and Grand Superior: grapes at least 20 MM (12.83% potential), wine at least 12.5% total and 12.0% actual.
hu-eger.max_yield: Classicus 100 hl/ha (13.6 t/ha hand-picked); Superior 60 hl/ha (8.1 t/ha); Grand Superior 35 hl/ha (6.0 t/ha).
hu-eger.styles: Generic district types plus Classicus, Superior and Grand Superior (white, red, rose, siller, late harvest). Egri Bikaver (red blend) and Egri Csillag (white blend) have their own rules; any bull image or "bull's blood" wording is reserved for Egri Bikaver, any star image or "csillag" for Egri Csillag.
hu-eger.labelling: Grand Superior must name a dulo. Village names need 85% origin; dulo names (Grand Superior only) need 95%. Superior/Grand Superior plantings since 2010 at least 4,000 vines/ha.
hu-eger.other: Egri Bikaver (separate PDO spec, from the 2023/24 marketing year): blend of at least four varieties each above 5%, Kekfrankos 30 to 65% and the largest component, Turan max 10% (Turan and Bibor Kadarka max 10% in Classicus); varieties Kekfrankos, Kadarka, Kekoporto, Blauburger, Zweigelt, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Sauvignon, Pinot Noir, Syrah, Menoire, Turan (plus Bibor Kadarka in Classicus). Classicus: at least 8 days on skins, 6 months in wood (except light varieties), 12.0% minimum, 100 hl/ha, released 1 September after harvest. Superior: at least 14 days on skins, 12 months in wood, 12.5%, 60 hl/ha, class I and II/1 land only, released 31 October after harvest. Grand Superior: as Superior plus 35 hl/ha and a mandatory named dulo (95% from it). Max 5 g/l sugar, no sweetening, vintage mandatory, glass bottles only.

hu-tokaj.varieties: Furmint, Harslevelu, Kabar, Koverszolo, Sargamuskotaly (Muscat Blanc a Petits Grains), Zeta only (still and sparkling).
hu-tokaj.min_alcohol: Minimum total alcohol / actual alcohol / residual sugar: Eszencia 27.75% total, 1.2 to 8.0% actual, at least 450 g/l sugar, acidity at least 8 g/l. Aszu 19% total, at least 9% actual, at least 120 g/l. Szaraz Szamorodni 12% actual, max 9 g/l. Edes Szamorodni, Forditas, Maslas: 16% total, 9% actual, at least 60 g/l. Kesoi szuretelesu (late harvest): 13.6% total, at least 45 g/l. Feher bor (dry/white): 10.6% total. Minimum grape sugar: aszu berries 45 refractometer % (438 g/l); Aszu, Forditas, Maslas base wine 19 MM; Szaraz Szamorodni and late harvest 21 MM; Edes Szamorodni 24.2 MM; white 17 MM; sparkling 14.9 MM.
hu-tokaj.max_yield: 10 t/ha (70 hl/ha) for all specialities and late harvest, aszu berries counted five-fold; Eszencia 2 t/ha of aszu berries and 6% juice yield; white wine and sparkling 14 t/ha (100 hl/ha); named dulo wines 6 t/ha (42 hl/ha). Only class I and II cadastre land in 27 villages.
hu-tokaj.ageing: Aszu at least 18 months in wooden cask; Szaraz Szamorodni at least 24 months in cask (traditionally under flor-like film); Edes Szamorodni, Forditas and Maslas at least 6 months in cask. Sparkling (bottle fermentation only) at least 15 months in bottle, 24 months for vintage plus 1 month after disgorging.
hu-tokaj.release: Eszencia, Aszu and Szaraz Szamorodni not before 1 January of the third year after harvest; Edes Szamorodni, Forditas, Maslas from 1 January of the second year; late harvest from 1 January after harvest.
hu-tokaj.styles: Eszencia (free-run juice of aszu berries under their own weight, barely fermented); Aszu (hand-picked botrytised berries macerated in must, fermenting new wine or wine of the same vintage); Szamorodni ("as it was born", whole bunches with botrytised and healthy berries; szaraz or edes, full name mandatory); Forditas (must or wine poured over pressed aszu paste); Maslas (must or new wine poured over Aszu or Szamorodni lees); late harvest; white; Tokaji pezsgo (traditional method). Ratios: max 6 L Eszencia per 100 kg aszu berries; Eszencia, Aszu and Forditas together max 220 L new wine per 100 kg aszu berries; Maslas max 105 L per 100 L lees. Adding Eszencia to Aszu is traditional.
hu-tokaj.sweetness: Aszu at least 120 g/l. Labels may still read Aszu 3, 4, 5 or 6 puttonyos, but "6 puttonyos" requires at least 150 g/l; with the 120 g/l floor the old 3 and 4 puttonyos levels cannot be met in practice. White wine must state sugar if above 18 g/l.
hu-tokaj.labelling: Vintage mandatory (85% rule). "Borkulonlegesseg" (wine speciality) may replace the PDO term for Eszencia, Aszu, Szamorodni, Forditas, Maslas; "muzealis bor" (museum wine) allowed. Dulo (single vineyard) names from the spec list need 100% site, 100% vintage and 100% variety if named. Specialities bottled only inside the region and only in the traditional Tokaji bottle (clear, cylindrical, long neck; mainly 0.5 L); late harvest and white wines also bottled locally. No enrichment, sweetening or acid adjustment for any speciality.
hu-tokaj.other: Hand harvest compulsory for all types except dry white; aszu berries picked berry by berry. New plantings since 2009 at least 4,000 vines/ha.

src.title: Tokaj PDO product specification, version 10 (harvests from 1 Aug 2025)

hu-villany.varieties: Reds: Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Kekfrankos, Kekoporto (Portugieser), Kadarka, Pinot Noir, Syrah, Zweigelt, Blauburger, Menoire. Whites incl. Olaszrizling, Harslevelu, Chardonnay, Tramini, Muscats. Super Premium: 100% Cabernet Franc only.
hu-villany.min_alcohol: Classicus grapes 14.9 MM (9% potential); Premium red 19 MM (Cabernets and Merlot 20 MM, Kadarka and Kekoporto 17.5 MM); Super Premium 20 MM (12.83%); late harvest 22.5 MM.
hu-villany.max_yield: Classicus 13 t/ha (90 hl/ha); Premium 8.5 t/ha (60 hl/ha); Premium late harvest 6 t/ha; Super Premium 5 t/ha (35 hl/ha).
hu-villany.ageing: Premium red at least 1 year in wood (Kadarka and Portugieser Premium 6 months); Super Premium at least 2 years, at least 1 of them in wood.
hu-villany.styles: Generic, Classicus, Classicus vörös Redy (light red from 51 to 66% Kekoporto plus 20 to 49% Blauburger, Kadarka, Kekfrankos or Zweigelt; screwcap only, no variety named), Premium, Super Premium; late harvest; sparkling and carbonated semi-sparkling.
hu-villany.labelling: Cabernet Franc at Premium or Super Premium must be labelled "Villanyi Franc"; Super Premium exists only as Villanyi Franc. Village names (85%) on Classicus, Premium, Super Premium; dulo names (95%) only on Premium and Super Premium. Single-variety labels need 85%. Premium and Super Premium must be made and bottled in Baranya county cellars, glass only. Sweet wines only from natural sugar of Harslevelu, Muscats, Olaszrizling, Rajnai rizling or Tramini.
